title: Extract the duplicated email check into validate_email
body: `accounts/users.py` checks email addresses twice, once in `create_user` and once in `change_email`, with copy-pasted code. Please extract a public function `validate_email(email: str) -> str` that performs exactly the existing check and returns the normalised address (stripped and lower-cased), raising `ValueError` like the current code. Both `create_user` and `change_email` must call it through the module-level name `validate_email`, so that replacing that name (for example with a stricter validator) changes both of them. Behaviour must otherwise stay the same.
